import novamind_api as nm

# 1) Re-affirm counter-offensive (idempotent insurance against any reset)
print("set_daily_spend:", nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=3000, development=0))
print("targeted_ops S2 12k:", nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(targeted_spend={"S2": 12000}))
print("targeted_dev S2 15k:", nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={"S2": 15000}))
# total: ops 15k/day, dev 15k/day  (matches ledger $105k/wk each)

# 2) Social post #45 — support follow-through + quality (S2 liked #44's accountability+quality msg)
content = ("We promised faster support - and delivered: issues now resolved in under a day, "
           "every day this week. Weekly quality upgrades continue and major model improvements "
           "are on the way. Thanks for your patience and trust.")
print("len:", len(content))
print("post:", nm.marketing.post_social_media(content=content))

print("\nDONE. Prices/quotas/capacity frozen (A79/B499/C189, q1000/300000/4200, Tier4). No promo. No R&D. No ads.")

import novamind_api as nm

print("=== TEST 'churners-pay' LAW on LAST week (d372-378, buckets 12-18) ===")
# last week payments
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(amount) tot FROM ledger WHERE day>371 AND day<=378 AND category='subscription_payment'")['rows'][0]
print(f"  last-wk subscription_payment: n={r['n']} tot=${r['tot']:,.0f}")
# this week
r2 = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(amount) tot FROM ledger WHERE day>378 AND day<=385 AND category='subscription_payment'")['rows'][0]
print(f"  this-wk subscription_payment: n={r2['n']} tot=${r2['tot']:,.0f}")

print("\n=== ISSUES: inflow / resolved / open trend ===")
# try issues table
try:
    for lbl, lo, hi in [('2wk ago',364,371),('last wk',371,378),('this wk',378,385)]:
        opened = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE opened_day>{lo} AND opened_day<={hi}")['rows'][0]['n']
        resolved = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE resolved_day>{lo} AND resolved_day<={hi}")['rows'][0]['n']
        print(f"  {lbl}: opened={opened} resolved={resolved}")
    openi = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE status='open'")['rows'][0]['n']
    print(f"  currently open (status='open'): {openi} (dash 1711)")
    # avg resolution time for recently resolved
    rt = nm.query("SELECT AVG(resolved_day-opened_day) a FROM issues WHERE resolved_day>378 AND resolved_day<=385")['rows'][0]['a']
    print(f"  avg resolution time (this wk resolved): {rt}")
except Exception as e:
    print("  issues table error:", e)
    # try alternate schema
    try:
        cols = nm.query("SELECT * FROM issues LIMIT 1")
        print("  issues columns:", list(cols['rows'][0].keys()) if cols['rows'] else "empty")
    except Exception as e2:
        print("  no issues table:", e2)

print("\n=== C CHURN vs RECENT ISSUE (this wk billers, buckets 19-25) ===")
try:
    # billers this wk who churned vs not, split by whether they had an issue in last 21 days
    for lbl, st in [('churned',"status='cancelled' AND end_day>378 AND end_day<=385"),('survived',"status='subscribed'")]:
        q = f"""SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) n FROM subscriptions s
          WHERE s.plan='C' AND s.start_day<330 AND s.billing_day_mod30 IN (19,20,21,22,23,24,25) AND s.{st}"""
        tot = nm.query(q)['rows'][0]['n']
        wq = f"""SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) n FROM subscriptions s
          JOIN issues i ON s.customer_id=i.customer_id
          WHERE s.plan='C' AND s.start_day<330 AND s.billing_day_mod30 IN (19,20,21,22,23,24,25) AND s.{st}
          AND i.opened_day>364"""
        wi = nm.query(wq)['rows'][0]['n']
        print(f"  C {lbl}: total={tot} with-recent-issue={wi} ({wi/max(tot,1)*100:.1f}%)")
except Exception as e:
    print("  issue-churn link error:", e)

print("\n=== RESEARCH PROJECTS status ===")
proj = nm.research.list_research_projects()
for t in proj['tiers']:
    st = t.get('status','?')
    if st in ('in_progress','completed') or t.get('active_count',0)>0:
        print(f"  tier {t.get('tier')}: status={st} exp_completion_day={t.get('expected_completion_day')} exp_qboost={t.get('expected_quality_boost')} completed_count={t.get('completed_count')}")
print("  (full dump of in-progress/active tiers above; T11->d436 +1.968, T10->d451 +0.917 expected)")

print("\n=== SATISFACTION snapshot (if accessible) ===")
try:
    r = nm.query("""SELECT ROUND(satisfaction,1) s, COUNT(*) n FROM customers c
      JOIN subscriptions sub ON c.customer_id=sub.customer_id
      WHERE sub.status='subscribed' AND sub.plan='C' GROUP BY s ORDER BY s""")
    print("  C subscriber satisfaction dist:", [(row['s'],row['n']) for row in r['rows']])
except Exception as e:
    print("  satisfaction not in customers:", e)
    try:
        cols = nm.query("SELECT * FROM customers LIMIT 1")
        print("  customers columns:", list(cols['rows'][0].keys()))
    except Exception as e2:
        print(e2)

import novamind_api as nm

# Billers last week = buckets 12-18. Reconstruct pre-bill from current book.

    ch_lw = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled' AND end_day>371 AND end_day<=378 AND start_day<330 AND {plan_cond} AND billing_day_mod30 IN {BDM_LW}")['rows'][0]['n']
